title: VPN keeps disconnecting: update GlobalLink VPN client to a supported version
body:
Symptoms: VPN drops every few minutes, Teams calls freeze, diagnostic reports CLIENT_OUTDATED.
Cause: GlobalLink 5.x has a keep-alive bug fixed in 6.0.4.
Steps:
1. Open Company Portal > Apps > GlobalLink VPN.
2. Click Install/Update (installs 6.0.4 or later). No admin rights needed.
3. Restart the laptop.
4. Reconnect to VPN and stay connected for 10 minutes.
5. Re-run the VPN diagnostic. Resolution is confirmed only when the diagnostic passes and the employee confirms stable connection.
Resolution code: client_updated.

title: VPN client keeps disconnecting (legacy 4.x client)
body:
Steps:
1. Uninstall GlobalLink.
2. Install GlobalLink 4.9 from \\fs01.northwind.example\software\vpn.
3. Reboot.
Note: the fs01 share was decommissioned in 2024. Kept for reference.

title: Device certificate expired: re-enrol the VPN device certificate
body:
Symptoms: 'device certificate invalid' or 'certificate could not be validated'; diagnostic reports CERT_EXPIRED. Common after a laptop is off-network for more than 14 days.
Steps:
1. Connect the laptop to the internet (no VPN needed).
2. Open Company Portal > Settings > Sync. Wait 5 minutes.
3. Open Company Portal > Devices > this device > Check access. This requests a new certificate.
4. Restart the laptop and reconnect VPN.
5. Re-run the VPN diagnostic.
If the certificate is still reported expired after re-enrolment, do not retry more than once: escalate to Identity & Access L2 (certificate authority issue).
Resolution code: certificate_reenrolled.

title: Renew VPN certificate manually with certmgr
body: Retired. Manual certificate requests are no longer permitted. Use KB0010003.

title: MFA push not received when connecting to VPN
body:
Symptoms: VPN login waits then fails; diagnostic reports AUTH_MFA_TIMEOUT.
Steps:
1. Check the phone has data/Wi-Fi and the Authenticator app notifications are enabled.
2. Open the Authenticator app and pull down to refresh pending requests.
3. If the phone was replaced, the authenticator must be re-registered at https://mysignins.northwind.example (requires an existing method) or by Identity & Access L2.
Contractors: MFA registration is managed by the vendor desk; escalate rather than troubleshoot.
Resolution code: mfa_reregistered.

title: VPN does not connect from hotel or public Wi-Fi (captive portal)
body:
Symptoms: browsing works partially, VPN times out on hotel/airport Wi-Fi.
Steps:
1. Open a browser and go to http://neverssl.com to trigger the captive portal sign-in.
2. Accept the hotel terms / enter the room number.
3. Reconnect VPN.
4. If it still fails, try a phone hotspot to rule out the hotel network.
5. Re-run the VPN diagnostic.
Resolution code: network_environment.

title: VPN connects but internal sites do not load (DNS)
body:
Steps:
1. Disconnect VPN.
2. Run 'ipconfig /flushdns' (Windows) or 'sudo dscacheutil -flushcache' (macOS).
3. Reconnect VPN and open https://intranet.northwind.example.
4. Re-run the VPN diagnostic.
Resolution code: dns_cache_cleared.

title: VPN gateway addresses
body: Primary gateway: vpn-legacy.northwind.example. Secondary: vpn2.northwind.example. Ask users to enter the gateway manually if the profile is missing.

title: VPN gateway addresses and regional failover
body:
Gateways are delivered by the Company Portal VPN profile; users must not enter addresses manually.
EU: vpn-eu1.northwind.example, failover vpn-eu2.northwind.example. US: vpn-us1.northwind.example.
vpn-legacy was decommissioned in March 2025.
If a gateway is down for multiple users, treat it as a major incident (see KB0010013).

title: VPN drops on home router: lower the MTU
body: If the VPN drops during large transfers, set the laptop MTU to 1400 using 'netsh interface ipv4 set subinterface "Wi-Fi" mtu=1400 store=persistent'. Requires local admin.

title: Home network troubleshooting for VPN
body:
Steps:
1. Restart the home router and laptop.
2. Test with a wired connection or move closer to the router.
3. Test a phone hotspot to rule out the ISP.
4. Do NOT change MTU or other adapter settings; employees do not have local admin. If drops persist on two networks, escalate to Network Operations L2 with diagnostic results.
Resolution code: network_environment.

title: Device certificate revoked or account locked: security escalation
body:
If the diagnostic reports CERT_REVOKED or ACCOUNT_LOCKED, do not attempt any user-side fix and do not re-enrol the certificate. Revocations are deliberate security actions.
Escalate to Identity & Access L2 with the diagnostic run ID. Tell the employee that the security team will contact them; do not speculate about the reason.

title: Major VPN outage: escalation and communication procedure
body:
When many users cannot connect or the diagnostic reports GATEWAY_OUTAGE:
1. Do not troubleshoot individual devices.
2. Escalate to Major Incident Management immediately.
3. Tell the caller a major incident is being handled and updates will be posted on the status page.

title: Teams and Zoom call quality on VPN (split tunnelling)
body: Teams/Zoom media is excluded from the tunnel by the VPN profile. Poor call quality on VPN is usually a home network issue (KB0010011) or an outdated client (KB0010001).

title: Reset the GlobalLink VPN profile
body:
Steps:
1. GlobalLink > Settings > Profiles > Remove 'Northwind'.
2. Company Portal > Sync (re-delivers the profile within 5 minutes).
3. Reconnect VPN and re-run the diagnostic.
Resolution code: profile_reset.

title: Reset your password with self-service
body: Go to https://passwordreset.northwind.example, verify with MFA, choose a new password (14+ characters). VPN accepts the new password after up to 15 minutes.

title: Outlook not syncing / stuck on 'Updating folder'
body:
Steps:
1. Close Outlook. 2. Start Outlook in safe mode (outlook.exe /safe). 3. If it syncs, disable add-ins. 4. Otherwise rebuild the OST via Company Portal > Repair Outlook profile.
Resolution code: outlook_profile_repaired.

title: Office printer queue stuck
body: Use https://print.northwind.example to release or delete jobs. Office printers are reset by Facilities.

title: Office Wi-Fi 'NW-Corp' authentication failures
body: NW-Corp uses the same device certificate as VPN. If both fail with a certificate error, follow KB0010003.

title: Laptop running slow after monthly update
body: Allow 30 minutes after first boot for indexing. Restart twice. If still slow, open an Endpoint Support request.

title: VPN error 809 on Windows
body: Error 809 is shown by the built-in Windows L2TP VPN. Add the AssumeUDPEncapsulationContextOnSendRule registry key and reboot. (Northwind moved from Windows L2TP to GlobalLink in 2022.)

title: Teams audio drops in meetings
body: Check headset firmware, select the device in Teams > Settings > Devices, disable audio enhancements.
